m: [n.] ; गहिर खेत जाहिमे बरिसातमे अधिक काल पानि रअछित अछि।; marshy field
e: An air mass of lower pressure; often brings precipitation; wetness caused by water; (ethnic slur) offensive term for a person of Irish descent.

m: [n.] ; गहींर खेत जाहिमे अधिक काल पानि रअछित अछि मुदा जेठ-बैसाखमे सुखाइत अछि।
e: An air mass of lower pressure; often brings precipitation; wetness caused by water; a piece of land cleared of trees and usually enclosed.
